scope: #10 OFI source semantic comparison from GitHub files only

historical.method: best bid/ask price transitions; computes bid and ask signed increments and bid-minus-ask; prev resets each snapshot
historical.paired_deltas: counts transitions after initial post-snapshot delta

current_rank.method: price transition separately for each of 1..10 fixed ranks; rank migration can be mislabeled OFI
current_rank.snapshot_handling: pb=pa=None on snapshot; first post-snapshot update has no paired calculation
current_rank.first_rank: rank index 0 uses same best-price transition algebra as historical top1 when at least 'levels' prices are present and both use same transition eligibility; results not certified numerically equal

current_membership.method: exact-price price×quantity quote-notional top-5 stock change separated into unchanged, entry, exit and membership effects; NOT OFI

unresolved: rank0 equivalence only algebraic under conditional event coverage; no immutable source-to-source replay, arithmetic float/Decimal precision differs
rank1..4 scores mix price-rank reindexing with queue change, so not strict price-identity multi-level OFI
snapshot boundary resets and entire-day paired-event coverage need separate QC
no source-side verified observed/available timestamps, independent causal measurement QC or per-instrument §21.6 passports

examples.case: best bid price advances, new best bid size 5
best bid price falls, previous best size 10
